Original description

First described in 2014:

Drosera aquatica Lowrie, Carniv. Pl. Austral. 3: 1268. 2014 [Dec 2013 publ. 2014]

IPNI record

Range given in the IPNI record of that publication: Western Australia (Australia, Australasia).

How well the identifier knows it

Of 16 validation photos of Drosera aquatica (photos the model never trained on), its top guess was right for 12. It gave a confident answer for 11 of them, and 11 of those were right.

Only 35 training photos: species with fewer than 40 are identified less reliably.

Most often mistaken for

  • Drosera indica (4 photos)
